capabilities: display multiple Bible versions side by side with synchronized scrolling
autocomplete verse references and insert a link or the full verse text
map Portuguese book names and abbreviations to Bible books
manage Bible, lexicon, commentary and cross-reference tabs from a dashboard
load Bible modules from JSON files stored in the vault
extras: The README is in Portuguese; the plugin only works with structured JSON Bible module files placed in library/bibles, downloaded from the damarals/biblias repository, and is distributed under a restricted non-commercial license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read Bible versions, lexicons and commentaries alongside notes or to convert typed verse references into links and verse text.

relations.evidence: Você pode encontrar e baixar módulos de versões da Bíblia compatíveis (como NVI, ARC

summary: Bible study environment that shows parallel Bible versions with synchronized scrolling and turns typed verse references into links or inserted text.
